summary: Queries the spatial grid for the collision feature containing a2; when a feature is found, derives an oriented collision normal from the feature's plane coefficients and writes it into the output vector a3. Returns the spatial-grid query result. Used by suspension force, orientation, tire contact and particle collision paths.

local_names.a2: query position vector (x, y, z) whose colliding feature is sought
local_names.v6: plane coefficient term assembled from position and feature elements
local_names.v7: plane coefficient term assembled from position and feature elements

operations.description: SpatialGridQuery(this, a2) looks up the collision feature associated with the query position a2; a non-null result drives the normal computation.
The collision normal is computed only when the spatial-grid query returns a non-null feature pointer.

Assemble plane coefficients from a2 components and result elements [0..4]: v6 = a2.x*result[0] + a2.x*result[0] + a2.z*result[2] + result[3]; v7 = a2.z*result[1] + a2.z*result[1] + a2.x*result[2] + result[4].
Normalization: v8 = 1.0 / sqrt(v7*v7 + v6*v6 + 1.0); the 1.0 constant is supplied by the read global dbl_59E420 (the only plausible consumer of that read).
Write the normalized collision normal into a3: a3[0] = -(v8*v6), a3[1] = v8, a3[2] = -(v8*v7).
Return the spatial-grid query result pointer (the feature, or NULL when no feature was found).

double v7 = a2[2]*result[1] + a2[2]*result[1] + a2[0]*result[2] + result[4];
